properties.name: intentflow.enabled
properties.description: Whether to auto-configure the IntentFlow pipeline.

properties.name: intentflow.executor
properties.description: Executor that runs queries and maps rows. When unset, the first available one wins: openmapper, jpa, spring-data-jdbc, cassandra, jdbc.

properties.name: intentflow.dialect
properties.description: SQL dialect. When unset, it is detected from the DataSource, or taken from the only dialect module on the classpath.

properties.name: intentflow.llm.base-url
properties.description: Base URL of an OpenAI-compatible chat completions API, e.g. http://localhost:1234/v1 (LM Studio), http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama) or https://api.openai.com/v1.

properties.name: intentflow.llm.model
properties.description: Model id sent to the LLM. Required unless the application defines its own LlmClient bean.

properties.name: intentflow.llm.api-key
properties.description: Bearer token for the LLM API. Leave empty for local servers.

properties.name: intentflow.cache.ttl
properties.description: How long a translated question is reused before the LLM is asked again.

properties.name: intentflow.catalog.packages
properties.description: Packages scanned for @IntentService classes. Defaults to the application's auto-configuration packages.

properties.name: intentflow.cassandra.max-scanned-rows
properties.description: Rows one Cassandra query may read before it fails. Conditions CQL cannot express, sorting and paging are applied in memory over these rows.

values.description: JPA native queries mapped to @Entity classes.
